prisoners.name: Elise Knaub
prisoners.description: Elise Knaub is a Chicago science teacher and activist arrested during the October 3, 2025 protest outside the Broadview immigration detention facility. She told the Chicago Tribune that federal agents held her for approximately eight hours and released her without charges. A court-filed CBP arrest chart independently records her arrest and lists prosecution as declined.

cases.charges: Federal officers recorded an allegation under 18 U.S.C. 111; prosecution declined
cases.sentence: Approximately eight hours detained, according to her interview with the Chicago Tribune; released without charges. No conviction or sentence. Exact release time and calendar date are not specified and remain unset. Sources: https://www.pulitzer.org/winners/staff-chicago-tribune (reproduced Tribune reporting, Staged photo shoot section); https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.ilnd.487571/gov.uscourts.ilnd.487571.284.40.pdf (page 1, October 3 arrest and Declined disposition). The chart historical custody flag is not used to infer current status; actual release is documented by the interview. Her husband Michael Boyte reported being tackled but not detained or charged and is not added as a prisoner from this event.
